mapper.select: SELECT USR.USER_ID /*getUserInfo*/ , USR.PWD AS PASSWORD , USR.EMAIL FROM TB_COM_USER USR WHERE 1=1 AND USR.USER_ID = #{loginVO.userId}

SELECT A.USER_ID /*getUserAuth*/ ,ARRAY_AGG(A.ROLE_CD) AS ROLE_CD ,ARRAY_AGG(A.ROLE_NM) AS ROLE_NM FROM (SELECT USR.USER_ID , ROLEUSER.ROLE_CD AS ROLE_CD , ROLE.ROLE_NM AS ROLE_NM FROM TB_COM_USER USR INNER JOIN TB_COM_ROLE_USER ROLEUSER ON USR.USER_ID =ROLEUSER.USER_ID INNER JOIN TB_COM_ROLE ROLE ON ROLE.ROLE_CD =ROLEUSER.ROLE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND USR.USER_ID = #{loginVO.userId} UNION ALL SELECT #{loginVO.userId} AS USER_ID , 'USER' AS ROLE_CD , '일반유저' AS ROLE_NM ) A GROUP BY A.USER_ID
select array_agg(user_id) as a ,email from tb_com_user group by email;
